description: Step 10 options-shock-sizing (docs/specs/options-shock-sizing.md): keyman_nvda becomes the largest-name event sized by the option-implied distribution of its lead (severity source 'options'), over the one-month option horizon (21 trading days). Upsert: no other scenario changes.

keyman_nvda.narrative: Largest-name event: an earnings or guidance miss (or a key-person / restatement event) at the book's largest single-name long, NVDA, with partial peer spillover through the covariance. Sized by the option market: the tiers are the 5% / 1% quantiles of NVDA's point-in-time one-month risk-neutral distribution (severe = adverse x 1.5, capped at the hard bound), not its history record.
keyman_nvda.trigger: 8-K 5.02 (officer departure) or 4.02 (restatement) from NVDA; results (2.02) as the news amplifier

companies.narrative_query: dependence on key personnel and founder/CEO leadership; concentration of technical and strategic know-how in a small number of individuals; succession and key-man risk

macro.synthesis_question: For an idiosyncratic NVIDIA key-man shock, a risk-off spillover in which IG credit spreads widen and MOVE and VIX rise, quantify any systematic one-month (21 trading days) spillover to IG credit spreads, MOVE, and VIX, with citations. (The single-name equity move is set separately.)
